documents.title: INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported record-breaking operational performance for FY26, achieving its highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT and record production levels for diesel, petrol, and LPG. Management highlighted a strong financial position with low debt levels and emphasized their focus on operational efficiency, energy conservation, and value-added product expansion. Despite global uncertainties and market volatility, the company maintains a positive outlook, supported by long-term crude supply agreements and ongoing strategic projects like the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS facility. The company remains committed to shareholder returns, having declared a total dividend of INR 62 per share for the year. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT for FY25, achieving 99.5% of its installed capacity.

guidance.claim: Management expects higher throughput in FY26 compared to the previous year due to a lower impact from maintenance shutdowns.
guidance.quote: Now, when you look forward 2025-26, the impact of shutdown that will happen in the current year is lower than that in the previous year. There is one unit shutdown, one primary unit. If you make a single index, it will be lower than what happened last year. So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the current momentum to continue into the new financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a clear shortfall of Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market, estimated at approximately 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 1,600 crores in a Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and INR 400 crores in a retail outlet project.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to spend approximately INR 500 crores annually on normal maintenance capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The new refinery project at Cauvery has a revised capital cost of approximately Rs 36,354 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for Q4 was $10.3 per barrel.
The company's GRM for FY25 was $4.22 per barrel, outperforming the Singapore benchmark of $3.79 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a core GRM of $3.75/bbl for the 9M 2024-25 period.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company is adding a new unit for Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS with a capacity of 250 KTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT in FY25, representing 99.5% of its installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net debt is less than INR 1,000 crores, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to INR 62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility as potential challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude prices and international product cracks pose challenges to profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge. Though these broader factors may drive volatility, we remain focused on things we control

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and retail outlet project over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company does not anticipate any major maintenance and inspection (M&I) activities in the first 6 months of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: First, reply to you , in the first 6 months, we don't see any M&I.

management_commitments.claim: Maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is expected to be in the range of Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: A crude unit and the lubes block are scheduled for maintenance in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: In the current financial year 2025-26, one of the other crude units will go for maintenance along with the lubes block as such.

management_commitments.claim: The company is developing future products including Sustainable Aviation Fuel, Propylene maximization, and Group II/III LOBS.
management_commitments.quote:
